criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: 03 and 04 meet the bold standard and 01 is lit on a dark wall; 07's mount and flat board read as primitive kit, 02 a grey-box plan with dark-stub cameras, 05 a mid grey grid sinking into the footer, 09's body reads as clay, 08 a pale page of type.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One dark operating-room world under one cold key, the container and camera motifs working, the 03 to 04 hold the strongest; values strobe 05 to 08 and gold leaks on 07 and 09.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; blog claims attributed; 08's quotes verbatim. The main estimate's own significance and the data's September 2023 end are not stated.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and where clear and honest; no action, body or deadline; the close's patient stake stays abstract.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover earns the swipe, 03 to 04 is a real reveal, 07 a declared turn and 08 lands; 06 stalls a lay reader; the close opens a new subject.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and on the house rules; a methods-summary register with paper language passed through.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A new world; the one-object-per-unit count and a Houston medical AI subject are familiar.

contested: 06's rank as good news or not significant
Leaving out the main estimate's significance is an emphasis call
Gold on 09 and the orange block on 07

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The boom arm runs from one wall plate to a second white plate; the board is flat coloured rectangles.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: One plate and a single two-joint arm; raised case magnets, a marker tray and frame edge casting under a raking key.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat grey-box floor plan with four dark-stub cameras.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A 30 to 40 degree oblique view; pale housings with lit lenses.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A mid grey grid whose last rows sink into the footer; bay 41 unmarked.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Shorten the bays about 15 percent; tape the high end at bay 41 too.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The body reads as matte clay; the camera wedged against the dek; an empty tile band.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A metallic low-roughness anodised material with a key streak; move the camera into the lit pool clear of the dek.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A pale page of type in the mid tones.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Narrow the key to the page's top half and the clip so the rest falls toward black.

_note: Transcribed from the judge's hand-back by the showrunner; scores, total and weakest frames as returned, reasons abridged.
